definition.description: Begin standing, hinge to contact the toes or ankles, lower/pull hips into a comfortable foot-supported squat, complete the assigned overhead reach sequence, stand tall, and reset. One repetition includes the whole contact-hinge-squat-reach-stand cycle. This excludes a static Deep Squat Pry, Cossack, lateral lunge, loaded squat, assessment, locomotor flow, and forced end range.

environment.space: room for hinge, squat, standing, and overhead reach
environment.changeRule: Changing contact, stance, support, range, reach side/order, tempo, load, surface, dose, or intent requires revalidation.

selectionPrerequisites: can perform the assigned small-range ordered cycle
clear stable surface, overhead clearance, and exit path
can control the assigned reach and stand without symptom escalation
understands the stop signal and session logistics fit
excludeOrEscalate: symptom, restriction, unsafe base, surface, support, overhead clearance, or communication conflict
sharp, increasing, unfamiliar, neurologic, circulation, breathing, chest, balance, or communication concern
notEstablishedByEvidence: universal contact depth, stance, reach, support, dose, recovery, outcome, readiness threshold, or clinical clearance

anatomy.laterality: bilateral lower-limb base; record assigned reach side/order

athleteSupport.whyItMatters: Candidate low-load hinge-squat-reach-stand work only when its exact order, range, support, and dose fit.
athleteSupport.primaryCue: Touch down without forcing, find a comfortable squat, reach as assigned, then stand tall and reset.
secondaryCues: make the range smaller before forcing contact or depth
stop before you rush, twist, or lose balance
expectedSensations: comfortable hip, knee, ankle, trunk, and shoulder movement
light foot and trunk control effort
unexpectedSensations: pain, numbness, tingling, dizziness, loss of balance, or a reach/stand that cannot be controlled

observationChecklist: exact contact, stance, support, range, and reach-side/order variant
foot, knee, hip, trunk, and overhead organisation
cadence, symptoms, and first quality loss

faultCorrections.forced_contact_or_depth: shorten range, add support, or stop
faultCorrections.rushed_or_out_of_order_cycle: reduce cadence and restore one ordered stage at a time
faultCorrections.overhead_compensation_or_balance_loss: reduce reach range, use support, or choose another reviewed task after revalidation

doNotUseWhen: the floor, overhead space, support, exit route, or communication is unsafe
the task conflicts with symptoms or restrictions
the intended task is a static squat pry, Cossack, lateral lunge, loaded squat, assessment, or locomotor flow

supportOperations.supportEscalation: Stop unresolved safety, symptom, base, support, or quality issues.
supportOperations.changeImpactPolicy: Any task change reruns selection, logistics, duration, fatigue, substitutions, and validation.

snapshot.description: Deep squat hold to stand with overhead reach.

requirements.cycleRule: standing hinge/contact, comfortable squat, one overhead reach per assigned side, stand, and reset is one repetition
requirements.rangeRule: comfortable contact, squat, reach, and stand without forced range or compensation

dosage.countRule: count only complete assigned contact-hinge-squat-reach-stand cycles with controlled reset

deliveryProfiles.qualityGate: The assigned ordered cycle, foot contact, trunk, reach side/order, stand, and reset remain controlled; range is comfortable; and no stop symptom appears.
stopRules: stop on pain, new symptoms, dizziness, unsafe support/space, or participant request
stop when contact, balance, range, reach, stand, or ordered cycle cannot be restored
deliveryProfiles.coachInstructions: Assign contact, stance, range, support, and reach side/order; check floor, overhead, and exit clearance; observe all stages and reduce range before adding volume; revalidate any alternate.
deliveryProfiles.athleteInstructions: Start tall, hinge to the assigned contact, lower into a comfortable squat, reach each assigned side, stand smoothly, reset, and stop before you force range or lose balance.
deliveryProfiles.expectedAdaptation: Candidate preparation only; no outcome is guaranteed.

doseScaling.reduce: shorter hinge/squat/reach range, fewer cycles, slower cadence, stable support, more rest, or another reviewed task
doseScaling.doNotAutoProgress: Do not force contact/depth/reach, add load, omit ordered stages, or substitute a static/lateral task without revalidation.

supportPrompts.coach: Difficulty describes the task—not an athlete-skill label.
